description: This source file defines the AgentWorkspace enum which manages file-based workspace setup and validation for an OpenClaw agent environment, including handling templates, directory structure, and bootstrap procedures.

methods.name: displayPath
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly display path for a given URL, abbreviating the home directory as '~'.

methods.name: resolveWorkspaceURL
methods.description: Resolves and returns a workspace URL from optional user input, expanding '~' to the home directory.

methods.name: agentsURL
methods.description: Constructs and returns the URL for the agents file within the given workspace.

methods.name: workspaceEntries
methods.description: Returns the list of directory entries in the workspace, excluding ignored entries.

methods.name: isWorkspaceEmpty
methods.description: Determines if the given workspace directory is empty.

methods.name: isTemplateOnlyWorkspace
methods.description: Checks if the workspace contains only template files and is otherwise empty.

methods.name: bootstrapSafety
methods.description: Assesses and returns the safety level of the workspace, determining if it's safe to bootstrap.

methods.name: bootstrap
methods.description: Initializes the workspace with necessary files and directories for agent operation, creating default templates if needed.

methods.name: needsBootstrap
methods.description: Checks whether the workspace requires bootstrapping based on its contents.

methods.name: hasIdentity
methods.description: Checks if the workspace has a meaningful identity defined in IDENTITY.md.

methods.name: identityLinesHaveValues
methods.description: Helper to determine if IDENTITY.md contains set identity values.

methods.name: defaultTemplate
methods.description: Provides the default content for the AGENTS.md workspace template.

methods.name: defaultSoulTemplate
methods.description: Provides the default content for the SOUL.md persona and boundary description.

methods.name: defaultIdentityTemplate
methods.description: Provides the default content for the IDENTITY.md agent identity file.

methods.name: defaultUserTemplate
methods.description: Provides the default content for the USER.md user profile.

methods.name: defaultBootstrapTemplate
methods.description: Provides the default content for the BOOTSTRAP.md first-run ritual.

methods.name: loadTemplate
methods.description: Loads template content from available sources, falling back to a default string.

methods.name: templateURLs
methods.description: Returns an array of URLs where templates might be found, including resources, local files, and development paths.

methods.name: devTemplateURL
methods.description: Constructs a development template URL based on the source file location.

methods.name: stripFrontMatter
methods.description: Removes front matter YAML from template content if present to return clean content.
